instructions: Describe yourself as you generally are now, not as you wish to be in the future. Describe yourself as you honestly see yourself, in relation to other people you know of the same sex as you are, and roughly your same age.

scales.name: Extraversion
scales.publishedName: Factor I (Surgency or Extraversion), 20-item scale, Big-Five Factor Markers

items.text: Am the life of the party.
Talk to a lot of different people at parties.
Don't mind being the center of attention.
Am skilled in handling social situations.
Don't like to draw attention to myself.
Find it difficult to approach others.
Wait for others to lead the way.

reliabilitySource: Coefficient alpha as given on the key page, https://ipip.ori.org/newBigFive5broadKey.htm, accessed 3 November 2026.
